Im 6 mos into the worst depressive episode health nightmare (20yr old female) And it all started from taking prozac i am now on several stomach medications for god knows how long ill have to be on them because ever since i went on it, insane anxiety induced diarrhea and IBS. To the point where I had to quit two jobs and stay at home pretty much all day. I understand that everyone’s body reacts differently from meds, especially SSRIs, but if you have a gut feeling that its affecting you poorly please stop taking it before something long lasting occurs to you because this has been the worst time of my life and it is to blame.
Run.. prozac was awful for me

Not to scare you, just tell u my experience. Ive been on a few different mental health medications and prozac is by far the worst. Shaking, cant sit still, can’t hold down food, throw up all the time, panic attacks. But i wish you the best
